name: Ban Ang rites
nameVi: Lễ hội Hết Chá, lễ mừng cơm mới
summary: A 2012 feature names Het Cha and the new-rice rite among the rites Ban Ang still holds, beside weaving and folk games. It does not print a month or the order of the rite. The date is check on arrival.
when: Check on arrival. The 2012 feature names the rites and does not print a day.
